results.evidence: - An LLM learns from training data and has a knowledge cutoff. - It cannot see private data and may hallucinate. - RAG adds a retrieval step before generation so the model uses fresh or private documents. - Documents are split into chunks, turned into embeddings, and stored in a vector database. - At query time the system retrieves, augments the prompt, then generates. - RAG does not retrain the model; updating knowledge means updating documents. - Benefits: up-to-date answers, sources, lower cost. Limitation: answer quality depends on retrieval.
